name: node-file-primitive
body: The edge-preserving node-file write primitives in src/layers.rs that this change builds: `refuse_if_present` — the refuse-on-existing guard `apg node add` runs before any write (replacing today's overwrite-exempting re-add); and `update_node_file` — read the existing NodeFile, mutate only the allowed fields (body/properties; name immutable), keep every out/in edge, and write atomically. Both are invoked by `node_add`/`node_update`, which call the existing write/validate/commit plumbing unchanged; `validate_change` itself is NOT modified by this change.
